senses.en_definition: One; a or an, used with things counted using the classifier buah.

messages.en: I've bought a used car. It's a bit easier to get to work now.
Wow, so that's why I saw you driving this morning! When did you buy it?
I've been working here for a month now.
That's gone by fast! Have you got used to the job yet?
How do you pronounce this name?
Listen first. I'll say it slowly, then you give it a try, okay?

senses.en_definition: In a particular way or manner.
With a particular attitude or intention; in the spirit of.
In accordance with a particular custom or tradition.

messages.en: Hey, did you call me earlier? I only just noticed the missed call.
Sorry! I accidentally hit the call button while scrolling through our chat earlier.
Haha, no worries. I thought it was something important.
